# PadelWrist

> PadelWrist is a padel scoring app for Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad. It is designed for wrist-first, distraction-free match scoring with one active match that can move between supported Apple devices.

Last updated: 2026-08-17.

PadelWrist supports standard padel scoring with games, sets and tie-breaks, Fixed Points scoring, server tracking, spoken score announcements, undo and score correction, saved players, match history, historic result editing and resuming unfinished matches. It does not require an account.

Apple Watch is the primary wrist-first scoring surface. iPhone and iPad provide larger-screen setup, scoring and match-management experiences. Active scoring is local-first, so a temporary device connection loss does not stop the scoring device. Apple Watch does not communicate directly with iPad through WatchConnectivity; where both participate in the same match, the paired iPhone provides the relay path.

PadelWrist does not currently organise Americano or Mexicano tournaments, rotate partners, generate pairings or standings, provide social networking or cloud accounts, or claim Apple Health and heart-rate features.

Contact: support@padelwrist.com

- [Apple Watch padel scoring](https://padelwrist.com/apple-watch-padel-scoring/): Wrist-first scoring, spoken scores, server tracking, undo, local-first behaviour and iPhone continuity.
- [Padel match history](https://padelwrist.com/padel-match-history/): Local match history, editing saved results, resuming unfinished matches and deletion.

## Padel knowledge base

- [Padel guides](https://padelwrist.com/guides/): Index of PadelWrist scoring, rules, social-format and scorekeeping guides.
- [How padel scoring works](https://padelwrist.com/how-padel-scoring-works/): 15-30-40 scoring, games, sets, tie-breaks, best-of-three matches and Fixed Points.
- [How to keep score in padel](https://padelwrist.com/how-to-keep-score-in-padel/): Practical match scorekeeping, server tracking, changes of ends and avoiding score disputes.
- [Padel tie-break rules](https://padelwrist.com/padel-tie-break-rules/): Seven-point tie-break scoring, two-point margin, serving order and changes of ends.
- [Golden point vs advantage](https://padelwrist.com/golden-point-vs-advantage/): Deuce, advantage, Golden Point and the 2026 Star Point option.
- [Padel service rules](https://padelwrist.com/padel-service-rules/): Underarm serve, bounce, waist height, diagonal boxes, second serve and service order.
- [Padel scoring formats](https://padelwrist.com/padel-scoring-formats/): Advantage, Golden Point, Star Point, tie-breaks, super tie-breaks, mini sets and Fixed Points.
- [Fixed Points padel scoring](https://padelwrist.com/fixed-points-padel-scoring/): Rally-point scoring for point-based matches and social formats.
- [Americano padel scoring](https://padelwrist.com/americano-padel-scoring/): Common Americano structure, fixed-point rounds, partner rotations and individual totals.
- [Mexicano padel scoring](https://padelwrist.com/mexicano-padel-scoring/): Ranking-influenced pairings, fixed-point rounds and individual totals.
- [Apple Watch vs phone for padel scoring](https://padelwrist.com/apple-watch-vs-phone-padel-scoring/): Practical trade-offs between wrist and phone scorekeeping.
- [Best padel scoring apps for Apple Watch](https://padelwrist.com/best-padel-scoring-apps-apple-watch/): Transparent comparison of current Apple Watch padel scoring approaches and use cases.
- [Padel glossary](https://padelwrist.com/padel-glossary/): Plain-English definitions for scoring, match-format and common padel terms.
